# Harvard Business Review

> > Harvard Business Review (HBR) — the leading publication for business leadership, strategy, management insights, and organizational development.

HBR provides research-backed articles, case studies, and practical advice for executives and managers. The platform also offers custom business simulations and experiential learning tools for training and higher education through partnerships with Forio and other educational technology providers.

## Key Topics

- Business Leadership
- Strategy & Strategic Management
- AI Transformation
- Executive Management
- Organizational Development
- Project Management
- Professional Development
- Experiential Learning
- Business Simulations
- Leadership Training
- Supply Chain Management
- Negotiation Skills
- Change Management
- Innovation & Growth
- Talent Development

## Main Resources

- [Harvard Business Review - Ideas and Advice for Leaders](https://hbr.org/): Harvard Business Review homepage: leadership, strategy & management insights

## Training & Simulations

- [Custom Simulations for Training and Higher Education](https://assessments.hbr.org/): Forio-powered business simulations for training (Everest, Beer Game, etc.)
